info.description: Gets a list of policy schemas that match a specified filter value for a given customer.
info.title: Chrome Policy API

requests.description: Creates an enterprise file from the content provided by user. Returns a public download url for end user.
requests.name: POST /v1/{customer}/policies/files:uploadPolicyFile
requests.note: Replace {{CHROME_POLICY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Delete multiple policy values that are applied to a specific group. All targets must have the same target format. That is to say that they must point to the same target resource and must have the same keys specified in `additionalTargetKeyNames`, though the values for those keys may be different. On failure the request will return the error details as part of the google.rpc.Status.
requests.name: POST /v1/{customer}/policies/groups:batchDelete
requests.note: Replace {{CHROME_POLICY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Modify multiple policy values that are applied to a specific org unit so that they now inherit the value from a parent (if applicable).
